figurative_meaning_en: Attractive to the mind; picturesque, satisfying to the heart
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার গান শুনে সকলের মন দিলখুশ হয়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: This garden view is truly heart-pleasing.
Everyone's heart was delighted upon hearing her song.
history: Derived from Persian 'dil-khush', influenced by Mughal-era literature in Bengal.
note: Variant 'খোশ' is a shortened form used colloquially.
